instruction.text: Select how the position of the comma changes the meaning of the sentences.

atoms.a: In which sentence does Ramsha collect silver and coins?
b: Ramsha collects silver coins, dolls and stamps.
++Ramsha collects silver, coins, dolls and stamps.

atoms.a: In which sentence does Ben like eating chocolate and ice cream?
b: ++Ben likes to eat chocolate, ice cream and cake.
Ben likes to eat chocolate ice cream and cake.

atoms.a: In which sentence does Mustafa buy quite a big necklace?
b: Mustafa buys a pretty, large necklace.

atoms.a: In which sentence does Sally enjoy taking her dog for a walk?
b: ++Sally’s enjoys walking her dog and rock climbing.
Sally’s enjoys walking, her dog and rock climbing.

atoms.a: In which sentence do three people go to the cinema?
b: ++After leaving, Jeremy, Kiara and Rob went to the cinema.
After leaving Jeremy, Kiara and Rob went to the cinema.

atoms.a: In which sentence does Adam think that Sean is a good painter?
b: ++Adam thought Sean was a good painter.
Adam, thought Sean, was a good painter.

atoms.a: In which sentence does someone want Aoife to cook soon?
In which sentence does the doctor think that Rodolfo was rude?
b: Rodolfo thought the doctor was very rude.
++Rodolfo, thought the doctor, was very rude.
